svg.text: National monthly job change · Simple exponential smoothing, α = 0.3 · Lower absolute error is better
Signed error: above zero = overprediction; below zero = underprediction
Grey region excluded from scoring: March 2020–December 2021. Pandemic observations remain in training.
Every target uses only earlier monthly observations. The 12-month average requires 12 consecutive scored months. Revised CSV history.
